issue.title: Add a bounded policy for very large Bob Mac Capture pastes
issue.description: Approved plan plan:202608/capture_paste_plain_text.md leaves very large pastes unbounded. Plain-text paste avoids rich import, but any large text edit still triggers the post-edit capture-parse and dry-run cascade without a size ceiling. It is cheap today for normal text, but unbounded in principle. Scope: define and implement a user-facing size/performance policy for large paste/edit events, keeping typing responsive and preserving draft correctness.
